mentions.name: sndlnk.io
mentions.description: A website that converts a sharing link from any streaming service into a universal link that works with all of them, including video game links.
mentions.problem: When sharing something, you often don't know which streaming service the recipient uses, especially in group chats or social media posts where people use different services.
mentions.audience: People sharing content with friends, group chats, and social media followers who may use different streaming services
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://sndlnk.io, a website that allows you to paste in a sharing link from any streaming service and get back a universal link that works with all of them.
mentions.author: dbmnt
